outcome: Change in Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) levels from before delivery to 3 months postpartum
cohort: 135 women with singleton pregnancies undergoing their first cesarean delivery (n=63) or vaginal delivery (n=72)
finding: Cesarean delivery did not significantly affect ovarian reserve as measured by AMH levels at 3 months postpartum compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery did not lead to a decrease in ovarian reserve as measured by AMH levels compared to vaginal delivery.
